create_screen.summary: Opens a screen for a player and hands back something that behaves like an inventory.
params: optional: called as `(screen, player, action, data)` — the actions are `'slot_click'`, `'button_click'`, `'select_recipe'`, `'close'`
create_screen.returns: `screen` — usable as an inventory with the functions of `core.mc.item`.
create_screen.note: Returning a true value from the callback cancels the action.

close_screen.summary: Closes the screen: the player goes back to their own inventory.

screen_property.summary: Reads or writes a property of the screen: the level of an enchantment, the progress of a furnace, the fuel.
params: the name of the property, which depends on the type of screen
screen_property.returns: the value of the property, or `bool` when writing.
